mapper.select: SELECT b.budget_id, d.dept_name, i.item_name, b.amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.status IN ('승인', '대기') THEN e.amount END), 0) AS used_amount, b.amount - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.status IN ('승인', '대기') THEN e.amount END), 0) AS remain FROM budget b JOIN dept d ON d.dept_id = b.dept_id JOIN budget_item i ON i.item_id = b.item_id LEFT JOIN expense e ON e.budget_id = b.budget_id WHERE b.fiscal_year = #{year} GROUP BY b.budget_id, d.dept_name, i.item_name, b.amount ORDER BY b.budget_id
